import collections
d0 = {}
d1 = {'one': 1}
d2 = {'one': 1, 'two': 2}
d3 = {'one': 1, 'two': 3, 'three': 5}
d4 = {'one': None, 'two': None}
d5 = {'one': 1, 'two': 1}

def _t():
    u = collections.UserDict()
    u0 = collections.UserDict(d0)
    u1 = collections.UserDict(d1)
    u2 = collections.UserDict(d2)
    uu = collections.UserDict(u)
    uu0 = collections.UserDict(u0)
    uu1 = collections.UserDict(u1)
    uu2 = collections.UserDict(u2)
    assert collections.UserDict(one=1, two=2) == d2, ('assertEqual', collections.UserDict(one=1, two=2), d2)
    assert collections.UserDict([('one', 1), ('two', 2)]) == d2, ('assertEqual', collections.UserDict([('one', 1), ('two', 2)]), d2)
    assert collections.UserDict(dict=[('one', 1), ('two', 2)]) == {'dict': [('one', 1), ('two', 2)]}, ('assertEqual', collections.UserDict(dict=[('one', 1), ('two', 2)]), {'dict': [('one', 1), ('two', 2)]})
    assert collections.UserDict([('one', 1), ('two', 2)], two=3, three=5) == d3, ('assertEqual', collections.UserDict([('one', 1), ('two', 2)], two=3, three=5), d3)
    assert collections.UserDict.fromkeys('one two'.split()) == d4, ('assertEqual', collections.UserDict.fromkeys('one two'.split()), d4)
    assert collections.UserDict().fromkeys('one two'.split()) == d4, ('assertEqual', collections.UserDict().fromkeys('one two'.split()), d4)
    assert collections.UserDict.fromkeys('one two'.split(), 1) == d5, ('assertEqual', collections.UserDict.fromkeys('one two'.split(), 1), d5)
    assert collections.UserDict().fromkeys('one two'.split(), 1) == d5, ('assertEqual', collections.UserDict().fromkeys('one two'.split(), 1), d5)
    assert u1.fromkeys('one two'.split()) is not u1, ('assertTrue', u1.fromkeys('one two'.split()) is not u1)
    assert isinstance(u1.fromkeys('one two'.split()), collections.UserDict), ('assertIsInstance', u1.fromkeys('one two'.split()), collections.UserDict)
    assert isinstance(u2.fromkeys('one two'.split()), collections.UserDict), ('assertIsInstance', u2.fromkeys('one two'.split()), collections.UserDict)
    assert str(u0) == str(d0), ('assertEqual', str(u0), str(d0))
    assert repr(u1) == repr(d1), ('assertEqual', repr(u1), repr(d1))
    assert repr(u2) in ("{'one': 1, 'two': 2}", "{'two': 2, 'one': 1}"), ('assertIn', repr(u2), ("{'one': 1, 'two': 2}", "{'two': 2, 'one': 1}"))
    all = [d0, d1, d2, u, u0, u1, u2, uu, uu0, uu1, uu2]
    for a in all:
        for b in all:
            assert (a == b) == (len(a) == len(b)), ('assertEqual', (a == b), (len(a) == len(b)))
    assert u2['one'] == 1, ('assertEqual', u2['one'], 1)
    try:
        u1.__getitem__(*('two',))
    except KeyError:
        pass
    u3 = collections.UserDict(u2)
    u3['two'] = 2
    u3['three'] = 3
    del u3['three']
    try:
        u3.__delitem__(*('three',))
    except KeyError:
        pass
    u3.clear()
    assert u3 == {}, ('assertEqual', u3, {})
    u2a = u2.copy()
    assert u2a == u2, ('assertEqual', u2a, u2)
    u2b = collections.UserDict(x=42, y=23)
    u2c = u2b.copy()
    assert u2b == u2c, ('assertEqual', u2b, u2c)

    class MyUserDict(collections.UserDict):

        def display(self):
            print(self)
    m2 = MyUserDict(u2)
    m2a = m2.copy()
    assert m2a == m2, ('assertEqual', m2a, m2)
    m2['foo'] = 'bar'
    assert m2a != m2, ('assertNotEqual', m2a, m2)
    assert sorted(u2.keys()) == sorted(d2.keys()), ('assertEqual', sorted(u2.keys()), sorted(d2.keys()))
    assert sorted(u2.items()) == sorted(d2.items()), ('assertEqual', sorted(u2.items()), sorted(d2.items()))
    assert sorted(u2.values()) == sorted(d2.values()), ('assertEqual', sorted(u2.values()), sorted(d2.values()))
    for i in u2.keys():
        assert i in u2, ('assertIn', i, u2)
        assert (i in u1) == (i in d1), ('assertEqual', (i in u1), (i in d1))
        assert (i in u0) == (i in d0), ('assertEqual', (i in u0), (i in d0))
    t = collections.UserDict()
    t.update(u2)
    assert t == u2, ('assertEqual', t, u2)
    for i in u2.keys():
        assert u2.get(i) == u2[i], ('assertEqual', u2.get(i), u2[i])
        assert u1.get(i) == d1.get(i), ('assertEqual', u1.get(i), d1.get(i))
        assert u0.get(i) == d0.get(i), ('assertEqual', u0.get(i), d0.get(i))
    for i in range(20):
        u2[i] = str(i)
    ikeys = []
    for k in u2:
        ikeys.append(k)
    keys = u2.keys()
    assert set(ikeys) == set(keys), ('assertEqual', set(ikeys), set(keys))
    t = collections.UserDict()
    assert t.setdefault('x', 42) == 42, ('assertEqual', t.setdefault('x', 42), 42)
    assert 'x' in t, ('assertIn', 'x', t)
    assert t.setdefault('x', 23) == 42, ('assertEqual', t.setdefault('x', 23), 42)
    t = collections.UserDict(x=42)
    assert t.pop('x') == 42, ('assertEqual', t.pop('x'), 42)
    try:
        t.pop(*('x',))
    except KeyError:
        pass
    assert t.pop('x', 1) == 1, ('assertEqual', t.pop('x', 1), 1)
    t['x'] = 42
    assert t.pop('x', 1) == 42, ('assertEqual', t.pop('x', 1), 42)
    t = collections.UserDict(x=42)
    assert t.popitem() == ('x', 42), ('assertEqual', t.popitem(), ('x', 42))
    try:
        t.popitem()
    except KeyError:
        pass
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    _oracle_write('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
else:
    _oracle_write('ok')

def _t():

    u = UserDict(u)
    assert u.data == d, ('assertEqual', u.data, d)
    assert type(u.data) is dict, ('assertIs', type(u.data), dict)
    u = UserDict([('a', 1), ('b', 2)])
    assert u.data == d, ('assertEqual', u.data, d)
    assert type(u.data) is dict, ('assertIs', type(u.data), dict)
    u = UserDict(a=1, b=2)
    assert u.data == d, ('assertEqual', u.data, d)
    assert type(u.data) is dict, ('assertIs', type(u.data), dict)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:

from collections import UserDict
import types

class UserDictSubclass(UserDict):
    pass

class UserDictSubclass2(UserDict):
    pass

def _t():
    for t in (UserDict, dict, types.MappingProxyType):
        u = UserDict({0: 'a', 1: 'b'}) | t({1: 'c', 2: 'd'})
        assert u == {0: 'a', 1: 'c', 2: 'd'}, ('assertEqual', u, {0: 'a', 1: 'c', 2: 'd'})
        assert type(u) is UserDict, ('assertIs', type(u), UserDict)
        u = t({0: 'a', 1: 'b'}) | UserDict({1: 'c', 2: 'd'})
        assert u == {0: 'a', 1: 'c', 2: 'd'}, ('assertEqual', u, {0: 'a', 1: 'c', 2: 'd'})
        assert type(u) is UserDict, ('assertIs', type(u), UserDict)
    u = UserDict({0: 'a', 1: 'b'}) | UserDictSubclass({1: 'c', 2: 'd'})
    assert u == {0: 'a', 1: 'c', 2: 'd'}, ('assertEqual', u, {0: 'a', 1: 'c', 2: 'd'})
    assert type(u) is UserDict, ('assertIs', type(u), UserDict)
    u = UserDictSubclass({0: 'a', 1: 'b'}) | UserDict({1: 'c', 2: 'd'})
    assert u == {0: 'a', 1: 'c', 2: 'd'}, ('assertEqual', u, {0: 'a', 1: 'c', 2: 'd'})
    assert type(u) is UserDictSubclass, ('assertIs', type(u), UserDictSubclass)
    u = UserDictSubclass({0: 'a', 1: 'b'}) | UserDictSubclass2({1: 'c', 2: 'd'})
    assert u == {0: 'a', 1: 'c', 2: 'd'}, ('assertEqual', u, {0: 'a', 1: 'c', 2: 'd'})
    assert type(u) is UserDictSubclass, ('assertIs', type(u), UserDictSubclass)
    u = UserDict({1: 'c', 2: 'd'}).__ror__(UserDict({0: 'a', 1: 'b'}))
    assert u == {0: 'a', 1: 'c', 2: 'd'}, ('assertEqual', u, {0: 'a', 1: 'c', 2: 'd'})
    assert type(u) is UserDict, ('assertIs', type(u), UserDict)
    u = UserDictSubclass({1: 'c', 2: 'd'}).__ror__(UserDictSubclass2({0: 'a', 1: 'b'}))
    assert u == {0: 'a', 1: 'c', 2: 'd'}, ('assertEqual', u, {0: 'a', 1: 'c', 2: 'd'})
    assert type(u) is UserDictSubclass, ('assertIs', type(u), UserDictSubclass)
try:
    _t()
except BaseException as _e:
    _oracle_write('ORACLE_EXC ' + type(_e).__name__ + ' ' + repr(str(_e)))
